description: A graceful mix of mid-century American and Japanese fine china in soft whites, creams, and metallic accents, perfect for building out a wheat pattern collection or setting a classic holiday table. Featured is Kaysons Fine China Golden Rhapsody from Japan, a pattern dating to 1961 with delicate golden wheat sprays, along with Platinum Wheat Fine China from Japan showing slender silvery wheat stalks on bright white porcelain with platinum trim, including a serving platter, berry bowls, and a cup and saucer. Mikasa Narumi Spectrum 5504 fine china cups bring a crisp modern look with fine silver vertical striping, paired with cream saucers, while a large oval Kenmark China platter made in the USA and a Modern Star USA piece add more serving options with their warm ivory bodies and silver-tone rims. A cream stoneware creamer from Japan, marked dishwasher, oven, and microwave safe, adds an everyday-friendly accent, and the set is finished with soft white embroidered cotton napkins for a polished place setting. Please review all photos for details and condition of the items.

description:
Vintage Dip Pen Nib Collection  Esterbrook, Mallat, Muller & Others in Bering Cigar Box
Assorted collection of previously owned metal dip pen nibs and illustrated pen-nib boxes, housed in a wooden Bering Claro cigar box.
The collection includes assorted loose metal nibs and multiple small cardboard boxes from several manufacturers. Several boxes were reported as unopened.
Photographed Manufacturers and Markings:
Esterbrook & Co.  314 Relief Pens, boxes marked 100 Pens and Made in U.S.A.
Heintze & Blanckertz  German steel pen nib packaging, including boxes marked 144 Stuck Schreibfedern
Herm. Muller A.G.  Leipziger Stahlfederfabrik, No. 3703, marked 1 Gross Eilfedern
J.B. Mallat  French Plumes Metalliques, No. 12 Pointes Moyennes, boxes marked 100
Bering Claro  wooden cigar box marked Tampa, Florida
Some Esterbrook packaging includes distributor information referring to Cairo, Egypt.
The assortment contains numerous loose metal pen nibs of various shapes and sizes, including some gold-colored pieces.
Condition:
Previously owned collection with age- and storage-related wear.
The cardboard boxes show varying amounts of edge wear, discoloration, scuffs, creases, and surface marks. Some labels and packaging remain visually colorful, while others show more substantial wear.
Several boxes were reported as unopened. Their internal contents and quantities have not been independently inspected.
The loose metal nibs show varying surface finishes and possible discoloration or oxidation. Individual nibs have not been examined for corrosion, bends, or writing performance.
The wooden cigar box shows visible storage and handling wear.

The actual number of pen nibs and the contents of unopened boxes have not been verified. Quantities printed on packaging refer to the manufacturer's labeled contents and do not establish current quantities.
The exact production dates and metal compositions are unknown.
Included Contents:
One Bering Claro wooden cigar box containing the photographed assortment of pen-nib boxes and loose metal dip pen nibs.

description:
Mixed Lot 18-20 Polished Rough Gemstone Mineral Slabs Agate Jasper Wood

description:
Summit Collection Egyptian Pens Lot - 2 Pieces
Summit Collection, Egyptian Figural Ballpoint Pens
2010
This collectible set features two cast resin Egyptian-themed ballpoint pens produced by Summit Collection in 2010. Modeled as detailed sculptural figures with hieroglyphic engravings and metallic finishes, the set includes King Tutankhamun and the cat goddess Bastet.
Items Included:
King Tut Figural Pen - Gold and black painted cast resin with crossed arms and hieroglyphic barrel, marked  2010 SUMMIT
Bastet Figural Pen - Black and gold painted cast resin depicting the feline deity with decorative collar and tapered barrel
Condition:
Pre-owned with minor surface rub wear. Sculptural relief and hieroglyphs remain crisp. Writing functionality and ink levels are untested; pens may require replacement refills. Tips intact with no cracks or breaks.
Warehouse Location: Cleveland
Due to our lighting, white glare lines may appear on items - This is NOT damage
If you have any questions regarding the quality or authenticity of this item or general questions regarding and item, please click Contact Seller on the item page and send us a message. We are available to answer your questions Monday through Friday, 8 am - 3:00 pm, EST.
